note: 妖蝠受击+死亡试制：一条视频前段受击回正、后段死亡倒地，验证能否一条片段同时拆出两个动作。

parameters.prompt: The exact flying bat in the reference hovers in place, then is struck by an invisible blow: it flinches backward once with the head and wings jerking back, then recovers and returns to the exact original hovering pose and holds it for a moment. Then it is struck again and dies: the wings go limp and fold, the body drops straight down to the ground below and it lies still on its side on the ground until the end. Keep the same three-quarter left view, fur, ears and wing shape. Exactly two wings. No flying across the frame, turning around, flying away, second flinch, blood, wounds, open screaming mouth. Apart from the straight fall it stays at the same spot and size. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, smears, glow, energy, coloured light, liquid, spray, projectile, feathers flying off, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shockwave, rings, shadow or text.

result.reviewNote: 试制通过：12–24受击后仰，28回到悬停；72–88失力下坠，88起侧躺静止。一条片段可拆出受击和死亡。
